factors.display_name: 协商对外表达和隐私边界

prompt.zh: 在彼此都有余力时，我愿意交流当天较细微的感受。
prompt.en: When we both have the capacity, I am willing to talk about the subtler feelings of the day.

prompt.zh: 关系中出现担忧时，我倾向把它整理后告诉对方。
prompt.en: When a concern arises in the relationship, I tend to sort through it before telling the other person.

prompt.zh: 对我重要的经历，我希望伴侣理解它带来的情绪。
prompt.en: For experiences that matter to me, I want my partner to understand the feelings they bring up.

prompt.zh: 对方愿意倾听时，我较容易谈到自己的脆弱时刻。
prompt.en: When the other person is willing to listen, I find it easier to talk about moments when I have felt vulnerable.

prompt.zh: 关系气氛变化时，我愿意用语言核对彼此感受。
prompt.en: When the atmosphere between us changes, I am willing to check in about our feelings using words.

prompt.zh: 我重视双方能明确说出需要怎样的情感支持。
prompt.en: I value both of us being able to say clearly what kind of emotional support we need.

prompt.zh: 在双方明确愿意时，日常身体靠近会增加我的亲近感。
prompt.en: When we both explicitly want it, everyday physical closeness adds to my sense of connection.

prompt.zh: 即使过去接受过某种接触，我仍希望每次都能按当下状态决定。
prompt.en: Even if I have accepted a kind of contact before, I still want to decide each time according to how I feel then.

prompt.zh: 我愿意主动说明哪些身体靠近现在让我舒适。
prompt.en: I am willing to explain which kinds of physical closeness feel comfortable to me now.

prompt.zh: 对方询问或留意我的意愿，会让我更容易放松。
prompt.en: When the other person asks about or pays attention to what I want, I find it easier to relax.

prompt.zh: 我希望表达暂停或不愿意时，互动能立即停止。
prompt.en: When I say that I want to pause or do not want an interaction, I want it to stop immediately.

prompt.zh: 我的身体靠近偏好会随场景、状态和对象而变化。
prompt.en: My preferences for physical closeness vary with the situation, how I feel and the person involved.

prompt.zh: 稳定的共同时间会帮助我感到关系有连接。
prompt.en: Regular time together helps me feel connected in a relationship.

prompt.zh: 拥有不被打扰的个人时间会帮助我保持舒适。
prompt.en: Having uninterrupted time to myself helps me feel comfortable.

prompt.zh: 我希望陪伴与独处可以提前沟通，而不是彼此猜测。
prompt.en: I want us to discuss time together and time alone in advance rather than guess what the other person wants.

prompt.zh: 关系亲近时，我仍重视各自保留兴趣和社交。
prompt.en: Even when a relationship is close, I value each of us keeping our own interests and social connections.

prompt.zh: 生活节奏变化后，我愿意重新协商相处频率。
prompt.en: After the pace of life changes, I am willing to renegotiate how often we spend time together.

prompt.zh: 共同活动结束后，我有时需要独处来恢复精力。
prompt.en: After a shared activity, I sometimes need time alone to restore my energy.

prompt.zh: 是否向他人提及关系，我希望先和伴侣取得共识。
prompt.en: Before mentioning our relationship to other people, I want to reach an agreement with my partner.

prompt.zh: 我对关系在社交平台上的可见程度有自己的舒适范围。
prompt.en: I have my own comfort range for how visible our relationship is on social platforms.

prompt.zh: 在不同人群面前，我愿意分别讨论合适的关系表达方式。
prompt.en: I am willing to discuss separately how to talk about our relationship with different groups of people.

prompt.zh: 即使关系稳定，我也希望某些共同经历只留在双方之间。
prompt.en: Even when the relationship is stable, I want some of our shared experiences to stay between the two of us.

prompt.zh: 对外介绍彼此关系前，我重视双方都明确愿意。
prompt.en: Before introducing our relationship to other people, I value both of us explicitly wanting to do so.

prompt.zh: 当公开偏好变化时，我希望可以重新协商而不被指责。
prompt.en: When preferences about being public change, I want us to be able to renegotiate without blame.

3.en: Uncertain or depends on the situation

NA_addition.zh: 无法判断或不愿回答（不计分）
NA_addition.en: Unable to judge or prefer not to answer (unscored)
